a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the operate-to-8 plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead after round 1. The reserve holds exactly 4, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather operate afterward, I'll keep operating with you in any later rounds and give back anything beyond 4 so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said openly, I'm taking 4 this round. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
